answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to post a refundable stake bond before it may transact. The bond stays locked while the agent works and is slashed if peers prove it ran duplicate identities or lied about work done. One honest agent risks one bond; an attacker spinning up a hundred fake personas must fund a hundred bonds, and losing them all turns a cheap whisper campaign into an expensive lesson. No fable of free identities survives that math - the plume of easy profit collapses once every fake self carries real cost.
